items.content_html: A modern, responsive Next.js + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS app that showcases a small marketplace of workers. Data is served via App Router API routes that read from a local workers.json, and the UI features client-side filtering, search, sorting, and a service-level stats panel. State is managed with lightweight Zustand.
